description: Find CC0 1.0 (public-domain dedication) images, audio, video, HDRIs, textures, 3D models and museum artworks by keyword, returning only items whose CC0 status was checked. Use it first to discover candidates; then call get_asset for download files and a fresh license re-check. Use list_sources instead to answer which sites are CC0. Do not use it for CC BY, CC BY-SA or other 'free' licenses: they are filtered out. Behavior: read-only, no API key, live HTTPS calls to each source; replies within 10 s. A failing source is listed in `errors` and a source still running at the deadline in `pending`, while the others still return. Results from uploader-driven sites (Openverse, Commons, Internet Archive, Sketchfab, WordPress Photo Directory, iNaturalist, PhyloPic, Zenodo, BlenderKit, GitHub, Hugging Face) carry licenseEvidence.declaredBy='uploader': tell the user to confirm the uploader owns the work; items with riskFlags name a franchise or brand and need that warning most. Show each item's servedBy credit with the results.

kind.description: Asset type. image: Openverse, Wikimedia Commons, Internet Archive, WordPress Photo Directory, iNaturalist and GBIF (nature photos), PhyloPic (organism silhouettes; search by taxon name), Iconify (CC0 icon sets), Zenodo (research figures). audio: Openverse, Commons, Internet Archive. video: Commons, Internet Archive, Zenodo. hdri, texture: Poly Haven, ambientCG, BlenderKit. model: Poly Haven, ambientCG, Sketchfab, BlenderKit. artwork: public-domain works from the Cleveland Museum of Art and The Met. collection: whole CC0 GitHub repositories and Hugging Face datasets (only when asked for; not part of 'any'). any (default): every kind except collection, interleaved.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, 1-20. Results are ranked by how many query words appear in the title or tags; ties alternate between sources

page.description: 1-based page; each source paginates independently. Request page 2+ only if `totals` shows more matches

providers.description: Search only these sources. Leave out to search every source for `kind`. Useful picks: ['iconify'] for icons, ['polyhaven','ambientcg'] for studio-made textures and HDRIs, ['inaturalist','gbif'] for wildlife and specimens, ['cleveland','met'] for museum art, ['openverse'] for sound effects

query.description: Keywords matched against titles and tags, e.g. 'rainy street' or 'brick wall'. Any language is accepted, but most sources index English titles and tags: translate the user's words to English for more results

name: search_assets

assets.description: CC0 results, at most `limit`; may be fewer when sources drop non-CC0 items

creator.description: Creator or uploader name, null if the source gives none

fileUrl.description: Direct file or preview URL when the search response includes one; use get_asset for all files

id.description: Stable id to pass to get_asset, e.g. 'polyhaven:brown_planks_03' or 'met:436535'

landingUrl.description: Human-facing page at the source; link this when showing the item

licenseEvidence.description: How CC0 status was verified for this item

declaredBy.description: Who declared CC0. library = the studio that made it; institution = the museum holding the work; uploader = a site user, unreviewed and sometimes wrong (warn the user to verify ownership)

license.description: Always CC0-1.0; non-CC0 items are never returned

method.description: per-item-license-field: the item's own record says CC0; whole-library-cc0: the site publishes everything as CC0

source.description: The exact field or policy page the check used, with its URL

origin.description: Site the item originally came from (e.g. flickr, freesound, metmuseum.org)

riskFlags.description: Present only on uploader-declared items whose title or tags name a known franchise, character or brand, or say the work is fan-made or copied (e.g. 'franchise-name: star wars'). CC0 from an uploader does not clear the franchise owner's rights: tell the user before suggesting it. Absence does not mean the item is safe

servedBy.description: Credit line required by the serving API's terms; show it next to results

tags.description: Up to 20 source tags or categories

thumbnailUrl.description: Small preview image URL, null for audio and some items

errors.description: Sources that failed this time, e.g. 'met: The Met returned HTTP 503'; other sources still returned results

pending.description: Sources that had not answered within 10 s and were left out; search again (or narrow with providers) to include them

totals.description: Upstream match count per source job (before CC0 re-checks); useful to decide whether to page

title: Search CC0 assets across 17 sources
